title: Fix modified reason phrase not updating in mitmweb
answers: Why is editing the response reason phrase in mitmweb not updating the flow?
Why is the modified reason phrase not being sent in mitmweb?
How to fix response reason phrase updates in mitmweb?
body:
Symptom: Editing the HTTP response reason phrase in mitmweb does not update or send the modified reason phrase.
Root cause: `web/src/js/components/FlowView/HttpMessages.tsx:ResponseLine` sent `{ response: { msg } }` and `mitmproxy/tools/web/app.py:put` handled `"msg"`, but `mitmproxy.http.Response` only defines `reason`.
Fix pattern: Align frontend edit dispatch keys and backend attribute assignment with the model's attribute name (`reason`).
Constraints: Applies to HTTP response properties edited through mitmweb's flow update endpoint; does not apply to request fields or non-HTTP protocols.
applies: mitmweb flow editing for HTTP responses
says: Editing the response status text in the web interface does not save changes.
Custom response reason phrases entered in the web viewer are ignored when sent.
Changing the status message like OK or Not Found in the response fails.
The edited HTTP status description reverts back to original after modifying response details.
